subject: Summer 2026 Systems Software Intern Application
message: Hello Alex! Our engineering team at Strata was thoroughly impressed by your Raft consensus implementation in RaftKV. We have an open slot in our Core Infrastructure team for Summer 2026. Let us know if you'd like to schedule an introductory technical conversation.
